name: FAPEN
fix_description: In unstake, check the user staked balance instead of the contract total balance. Should be: require(stakedAmount[msg.sender] >= amount) and track per-user staked amounts separately.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-contract, single-bug exploit based on an obvious logic error in `unstake`, followed by a simple token swap to realize profit. The PoC is very short, requires minimal protocol understanding, and uses only 1-2 straightforward external interactions.
